title: Not-So-Powerful Pedestal Fan Works Well in Smaller Rooms
text:
Not-So-Powerful Pedestal Fan Works Well in Smaller Rooms. This HONEYWELL ADVANCED QUIETSET WHOLE ROOM PEDESTAL FAN (with Noise Reduction Technology, 16”) has a standard-size, fairly large fan (16”). It isn’t all that powerful, so it’s right for a small bedroom or office where you want to circulate air without blowing your papers around or creating a strong draft.

The remote control is a nice feature to have with a pedestal fan, which is usually located across the room from wherever you are. If you plug the fan into a WEMO switch (or other brand of smart switch), you can also use Amazon Alexa to turn the fan on and off.

With a pedestal fan, you don’t need to use precious desk, countertop, or tabletop space to hold the fan--it has its own stand. You can place it anywhere in the room, as long as the cord (or the cord with an extension cord) can reach an electrical outlet. Also, a pedestal fan moves the air in the top half of the room, where it does the most good.

However, in recent years I’ve become a fan of the Vornado whole room air circulators (see, e.g., [[ASIN:B00TX79BK6 Vornado Vintage Jr. air circulator]]). You can put one of those in the corner of a room, aim it toward the opposite ceiling corner, and the air will be turned over throughout the room.

product_metadata.title: Honeywell HSF600B Advanced QuietSet 16” Whole Room Stand Fan, Black – Ultra Quiet Pedestal Fan with Remote Control, Oscillation and 5 Power Settings
features: STANDING OSCILLATING FAN – The Honeywell Advanced QuietSet 16” Pedestal Fan features an ultra quiet operation plus oscillation for wide area cooling, making it ideal for medium rooms.
QUIET COOLING – This oscillating fan offers 5 power and sound settings, including an ultra quiet “sleep” setting. It also has an adjustable head and height, remote control and auto-off timer.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR COMFORT – With 5 power settings on this portable standing fan, oscillation, an adjustable head and adjustable height, you can customize your cooling needs whenever and however you like.

SMART SAVINGS – Fans for home are an easy way to cool down any space and improve airflow. Give your air conditioner a break by using a portable indoor fan to help reduce your energy consumption and costs.

HONEYWELL QUALITY – Help improve cooling and energy savings in your home, bedroom or office using a Honeywell fan. We offer personal fans, whole room fans, tower fans and oscillating fans that are a great choice.
